⚠️ IMPORTANT: Always check that you are using the official Vietnamese government e-Visa website before entering your personal details or making a payment.

In this video, I’ll show you how to apply for a Vietnam E-Visa online, step-by-step, specifically for Indian travellers.

In this complete Vietnam E-Visa guide, I’ll walk you through the official application website, required documents, application form, passport details, photo upload, travel information, payment, application tracking and downloading your approved Vietnam E-Visa.

The Vietnam E-Visa is available for eligible foreign travellers and can be issued for up to 90 days, with single-entry or multiple-entry options. The official e-Visa fees are currently US$25 for single entry and US$50 for multiple entry.

comments.author: @SathishKumar-o3f
comments.text: I want a job in Vietnam. Can you please the explain how can I do this and Explain the all process and Procedures.

comments.author: @itsvirtualvisa
comments.text:
Hi…by using your tourist visa yes, you can search for a job, but you CANNOT legally work on a Tourist Visa. 

If you enter on a Tourist Visa to search for jobs locally:
1. Attend interviews and sign the employment agreement in Vietnam.
2. Employer processes your Work Permit documents locally.  
3. Do a quick "Visa Run" (fly/bus to neighboring Cambodia, Thailand, or Laos) to switch from Tourist Visa to your new Work Visa, then re-enter Vietnam.
